title: Ladybug holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d="M60 42 Q58 50 55 56" stroke="#FFD166" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="30" rx="11" ry="14" fill="#FF6B6B"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="26" rx="4" ry="6" fill="#FF9E9E" opacity="0.7"/>
  <polygon points="60,44 62,43 61,46" fill="#E05555"/>
  <!-- Ladybug body -->
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="68" rx="20" ry="16" fill="#CC2222"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="56" r="9" fill="#661111"/>
  <!-- Antennae -->
  <path d="M30 50 Q26 42 22 40" stroke="#661111" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="21" cy="39" r="2" fill="#FFD166"/>
  <path d="M38 49 Q40 41 44 38" stroke="#661111" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="37" r="2" fill="#FFD166"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="55" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="32" cy="55" r="1.5" fill="#222244"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="55" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="55" r="1.5" fill="#222244"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M32 61 Q36 65 40 61" stroke="#FFD166" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Wing line -->
  <line x1="45" y1="52" x2="45" y2="82" stroke="#661111" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Spots -->
  <circle cx="33" cy="68" r="4" fill="#222244"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="68" r="4" fill="#222244"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="77" r="3.5" fill="#222244"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="77" r="3.5" fill="#222244"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="58" r="3" fill="#222244"/>
  <!-- Dots on wings lighter -->
  <circle cx="33" cy="68" r="1.5" fill="#444466"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="68" r="1.5" fill="#444466"/>
  <!-- Arm holding string -->
  <path d="M55 62 Q60 59 60 55" stroke="#CC2222" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <path d="M28 72 Q22 76 20 82" stroke="#661111" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M32 78 Q28 84 26 88" stroke="#661111" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M62 72 Q68 76 70 82" stroke="#661111" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M58 78 Q62 84 64 88" stroke="#661111" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <circle cx="20" cy="83" r="2" fill="#FFD166"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="89" r="2" fill="#FFD166"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="83" r="2" fill="#FFD166"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="89" r="2" fill="#FFD166"/>
</svg>
